passages.text: Mr Chen and his wife make breakfast at their small shop every morning. Their daughter takes a photograph of the busy scene for her school project. In the photograph, one person cooks while the other speaks to waiting customers. The daughter asks permission before including anyone's face in her display. She also writes short notes about the different jobs her parents share. Her classmates enjoy learning how one ordinary family works together to begin the day.

parallelText.en: Mr Chen and his wife make breakfast at their small shop every morning.
parallelText.zh: 陈先生和妻子每天早晨在小店里做早餐。

parallelText.en: Their daughter takes a photograph of the busy scene for her school project.
parallelText.zh: 女儿为学校课题拍下这个忙碌场面的照片。

parallelText.en: In the photograph, one person cooks while the other speaks to waiting customers.
parallelText.zh: 照片里，一人做饭，另一人与等候的顾客说话。

parallelText.en: The daughter asks permission before including anyone's face in her display.
parallelText.zh: 女儿把人物面孔放入展示前先征求同意。

parallelText.en: She also writes short notes about the different jobs her parents share.
parallelText.zh: 她还简短记录父母分担的不同工作。

parallelText.en: Her classmates enjoy learning how one ordinary family works together to begin the day.
parallelText.zh: 同学们喜欢了解一个普通家庭怎样合作开始一天。

passages.text: Our museum has a small room where children can try painting. Mia uses a brush and two colours to show a rainy street. She leaves some white space so the lights seem to shine on the wet road. Her artwork is only one of many different things in the room. There are clay animals, paper flowers and drawings by younger visitors too. Before leaving, everyone shares one idea about how they made their work. The room shows us that people can express ideas in more than one way.

parallelText.en: Our museum has a small room where children can try painting.
parallelText.zh: 博物馆有一间供孩子尝试绘画的小房间。

parallelText.en: Mia uses a brush and two colours to show a rainy street.
parallelText.zh: 米娅用画笔和两种颜色画雨中的街道。

parallelText.en: She leaves some white space so the lights seem to shine on the wet road.
parallelText.zh: 她留下一些白色，让灯光看起来映照在湿路面上。

parallelText.en: Her artwork is only one of many different things in the room.
parallelText.zh: 她的艺术作品只是房间里许多不同作品中的一件。

parallelText.en: There are clay animals, paper flowers and drawings by younger visitors too.
parallelText.zh: 还有陶土动物、纸花，以及更小访客的画。

parallelText.en: Before leaving, everyone shares one idea about how they made their work.
parallelText.zh: 离开前，大家分享一个关于自己怎样创作的想法。

parallelText.en: The room shows us that people can express ideas in more than one way.
parallelText.zh: 这个房间让我们明白，人们有不止一种表达想法的方式。
